CFTC Submits Crypto Market Rule Proposal for White House Review as CLARITY Act Stalls A regulatory filing on the White House Office of Management and Budget (OMB) website indicates that the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) submitted a proposal to regulate cryptocurrency trading and markets on September 17. The submission follows the Senate’s failure to advance the CLARITY Act, which would have granted the CFTC primary authority over digital asset markets. The proposal is under review and has not been finalized. — link

VerifiedX Joins Bitcoin For Corporations, Becomes Exclusive Custody-Category Partner for Bitcoin Magazine TV VerifiedX has joined Bitcoin For Corporations as an Executive member and vendor to advance Bitcoin as programmable financial infrastructure. Additionally, VerifiedX has also become the exclusive custody-category partner for the newly launched Bitcoin Magazine TV (BMTV). VFX is a financial operating system designed to turn Bitcoin into programmable financial infrastructure for payments, settlement, treasury management, lending and liquidity. Its core asset, Verified Bitcoin (vBTC), is a 1:1 Bitcoin-backed evergreen asset built on the VerifiedX network and redeemable to native BTC at all times without intermediaries or third-parties. The alignment with BFC and BMTV comes on the heels of recent partnerships with BitGo, Kraken, and Cantor Fitzgerald. — link

Binance Research: Onchain RWA Assets Reach $34.18B, Up 85.2% YTD Binance Research’s “The RWA Activation Era” report shows that onchain real-world assets reached $34.18 billion as of September 15, 2026, up 85.2% year to date. Bonds and money market funds led with $18.29 billion, while tokenized equities grew 390.4% YTD; together, the two categories accounted for more than three-quarters of new market value. Binance Research estimates that only about 0.01% of underlying assets have been tokenized, while roughly 12% of onchain RWA value is actively deployed across liquidity pools, lending, and collateral markets. The report argues that the next phase of RWA growth will depend not only on bringing more assets onchain, but also on making them usable across DeFi. — link

Coinbase Files to Launch Single-Stock and ETF Perpetual Futures in the U.S. Coinbase Derivatives has filed with the CFTC for approval to launch cash-settled perpetual futures referencing individual U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs. The products would target the U.S. market and launch following CFTC approval and any other necessary regulatory approvals, with Apple (AAPL) used as the representative contract in the filing. Coinbase already offers equity perpetual futures to eligible non-U.S. users, while the new filing seeks to bring such products into the U.S. regulated market. The contracts would be regulated as security futures products under the joint jurisdiction of the CFTC and SEC. — link
